|quest_reward4_quest_id = a6q4 |quest_reward4_act = 6 |quest_reward4_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Shockwave Support''' is a [[support gem]] that causes the supported [[attack]] skill to [[trigger]] Shockwave on [[hit]], damaging the enemy and enemies near it. It causes the supported skill to be restricted to [[staff|staves]] and [[mace]]s. ==Skill functions and interactions== *'''Restrictions''': Supports melee attack skills. Supported Skills can only be used with Maces, Sceptres or Staves. Cannot support triggered attacks, attacks used by things other than you, or skills which create minions. *'''Strike Skills target # additional nearby Enemies''': Additional target effects such as {{il|Ancestral Call Support}} will proc the shockwave, provided additional stored uses are available. *'''[[Area of effect]] attacks''': Shockwaves will proc for each enemy hit by area of effect attacks, as long as there are cooldowns available. For example, when supporting {{Il|Earthshatter}}, Shockwaves will proc for the initial hit, each enemy hit by each fissure, and each enemy hit by each of the shattering spikes, with every instance consuming a stored use. This makes it a good choice for slow- and single-hitting skills, and a poor one for every other type of melee attack as the cooldowns will deplete too rapidly. * The Shockwave's damage is independent of the hit that triggered it, though it is affected by linked support gems. * Like all [[trigger]]ed attacks, Shockwave cannot be [[exerting|exerted]] or [[repeat]]. * Assuming no other increases/decreases to cooldown recovery, the time it takes for a level 21 normal gem to store 5 shockwaves is 3.6 seconds, or 1 shockwave per 0.72 seconds. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Radius |c1_header = Base radius is x metres |c1_pattern_extract = Base radius is (%d+%.*%d*) metres |c1_pattern_value = %sm |c2_abbr = Cooldown

It is available in permanent leagues only as a [[legacy item]]. ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.25.0| * Now has 230% Effectiveness of Base and Added Damage at gem level 1 (previously 160%), scaling up to 336% at gem level 20 (previously 260%). }} {{Version history table row|3.15.0d| * Shockwave Support now has a Cost and Reservation Multiplier of 140% (previously 150%). }} {{Version history table row|3.15.0| * Now has a 150% Cost and Reservation Multiplier (previously 140%). }} {{Version history table row|3.11.0| * Now gains additional uses as the gem levels up, up to 4 at gem level 20. * Now deals 160% of base Damage at gem level 1 (unchanged), up to 260% at gem level 20 (from 210%) }} {{Version history table row|3.7.0| * Shockwave Support has been added to the game. ** Added Shockwave Support as a reward for the Templar and Marauder for completing Sharp and Cruel. ** Shockwave Support becomes available from Yeena for Duelist and Scion after completing Sharp and Cruel. }} {{Version history table end}} {{Navbox Support Gems}}
